data.name: NetZero
data.description: NetZero is a French biochar company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Paris that produces biochar at industrial scale from tropical crop residues such as coffee husks and sugarcane. It operates plants in Cameroon and Brazil (4 sites, plus a new sugarcane-focused site under construction in Minas Gerais), and won $15M as first runner-up in the XPRIZE Carbon Removal competition in April 2025.
